title: Longest Valid Parentheses

monster.name: Parenthesis Titan
monster.title: Keeper of Unbroken Nestings
monster.defeatQuote: Stack index tracking calculated the longest unbroken well-formed span!

description: Given a string containing just the characters `'('` and `')'`, return the length of the longest valid (well-formed) parentheses substring.
hints: Initialize stack with -1 as boundary. Pop on ')'; if stack empty push current index, else compute i - stack[-1].
